title: One year refractive outcomes of Femtosecond-LASIK in mild, moderate and high myopia

indication: mild, moderate and high myopia (whole cohort tabulated; low preoperative cylinder)

groups.description: Femtosecond-LASIK (VisuMax flap, MEL 80 excimer ablation), myopic eyes; attempted result emmetropia in all cases; prospective, 60 eyes (31 right, 29 left) of 36 patients analysed

exclusions.reason: individual eyes of a case presentation: manifest refraction printed as sphere^cylinder without an SE, no tabulated preoperative refraction (preoperative refraction only in text), membership in the cohort not stated

not tabulated for the cohort (only plotted)

notes: Target: Methods state 'The surgical attempted result was emmetropia in all cases'; target recorded as plano.
Method: manifest SE (Table 2 title and row label; Methods: manifest refraction measured at each visit).

Attrition: 66 eyes of 40 patients were treated; three bilaterally treated patients were lost to follow-up after the first month visit; 60 eyes of 36 patients (patient count as printed) are analysed at every tabulated visit (not outcome-defined).
Twelve patients treated for myopia in one eye had the fellow eye treated for compound myopic astigmatism; those fellow eyes are not described as part of the 60-eye cohort.
Bilaterally treated patients contribute both eyes (fellow-eye correlation).
Corneal thickness and visual acuity are reported in text; keratometry and pachymetry for the case patient in Tables 3-4 (not extracted).

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 2 header 'Diopters (mean±SD)'); rows Preoperative, Postoperative 1 day, 1 month and 12 months; some cells print the minus sign as an en dash (read as minus); per-visit n not reported (caption: the 60 myopic eyes)
